codes.title: Acute angle-closure glaucoma
evidence_quotes: Severe right eye pain with blurred vision and haloes around lights since evening, eye red and hard, vomiting.
codes.reasoning: The patient presents with the classic triad and associated signs of acute angle-closure glaucoma, including severe unilateral eye pain, blurred vision with haloes around lights, a red and hard eye, and associated vomiting. Per GDL-023, this distinct clinical pattern warrants the diagnosis of acute angle-closure glaucoma.
